description: Tone analysis of a text (max 10,000 characters): formality 0-1, sentiment, emotion scores, tone labels such as friendly, aggressive or urgent, and short suggestions. The reading level (Flesch-Kincaid grade) is computed in code with a simple syllable count, so treat it as an estimate. Model judgements are not measurements. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: text_tone
title: Text Tone
